description: Independent plumbing fittings reference library, comparison checklists and supplier due diligence guidance for international buyers.
intro: For overseas importers and technical buyers: organize pipe-fitting requirements into a bilingual RFQ checklist before comparing manufacturers. Independent guidance only—no sales, supplier endorsement or product certification.
heroCardTitle: The right fitting starts with the right questions.
heroCardCopy: Material, thread profile, working conditions and local compliance requirements matter more than a matching photo.

topics.title: Threads & connections
topics.summary: BSP, NPT, compression, press and push-fit systems are not universally interchangeable.

topics.title: Material selection
topics.summary: Brass, copper, stainless steel and polymers require application-specific material checks.

topics.title: Pressure, temperature & media
topics.summary: Working conditions and approvals influence whether a valve or fitting is suitable.

products.name: Brass threaded elbow
products.description: A direction-changing connector used in threaded pipework assemblies.
products.spec: Nominal size, male/female threads, thread type, material designation.
products.caution: Check BSP/NPT thread compatibility and applicable drinking-water rules.

products.name: Compression coupling
products.description: A mechanical connector often selected for compatible copper or plastic tubing.
products.spec: Tube outside diameter, ferrule design, pipe compatibility, pressure rating.
products.caution: Installation procedures and permitted tubing vary by system.

products.name: Ball valve
products.description: Quarter-turn isolation valve frequently used in fluid distribution systems.
products.spec: Bore size, body/seat material, valve rating, end connections.
products.caution: Valve ratings must match temperature, pressure and service medium.

products.name: Check valve
products.description: One-way valve intended to reduce reverse flow in compatible systems.
products.spec: Cracking pressure, orientation, connection, materials, test standard.
products.caution: Not a substitute for a legally required backflow prevention assembly.

products.name: Stainless steel tee
products.description: Three-way branch connector for piping installations.
products.spec: Grade, branch sizing, schedule/wall thickness, joining method.
products.caution: Confirm exact grade and test documents with the manufacturer.

products.name: Pressure reducing valve
products.description: Regulating valve used where downstream pressure must be controlled.
products.spec: Inlet range, adjustable outlet range, flow capacity, certifications.
products.caution: Selection and installation should be checked by a qualified professional.

guides.title: BSP vs NPT: what to check
guides.summary: Nominally similar threaded fittings can differ in profile and sealing approach.
checks: Confirm the exact thread standard and size on drawings.
Ask for dimensions or gauges—not a product photo alone.
Specify sealing method, fluid type and local code requirements.

guides.title: How to write a clearer RFQ
guides.summary: Incomplete specifications cause wrong quotations and costly substitutions.
checks: List quantity, drawing and end-use conditions.
State test reports, material certificates and packaging requirements.
Ask for sample policy, lead time, trade terms and exclusions.

guides.title: Checking a valve quotation
guides.summary: Price comparisons only matter when the technical basis matches.
checks: Confirm material grades and genuine test documents.
Compare pressure/temperature envelopes and product standards.
Clarify inspection scope, spare parts and warranty terms.

faq.question: Does this site sell fittings?
faq.answer: No. This is an educational reference prototype; there is no checkout or live supplier quotation service.

faq.question: Can two similar-looking fittings use the same threads?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Thread geometry and applicable sealing methods can differ. Confirm by standard and drawing rather than appearance.

faq.question: Are the manufacturers verified?
faq.answer: No manufacturer profiles have been published. Future listings will distinguish public records, supplier declarations and independently reviewed documents.

disclosure: Technical notes are general education, not engineering approval, purchase advice or proof of product compliance.

zh-CN.description: 独立水暖管件参考库，为国际采购者提供规格比较清单和供应商尽职调查指南。
zh-CN.hero: 让每一项管件规格都有依据。
zh-CN.intro: 面向海外进口商与技术采购人员：先将管件需求整理成中英文询价核对清单，再比较制造商。本站仅提供独立采购知识，不销售产品、不为供应商背书，也不提供产品认证。
zh-CN.heroCardTitle: 选对管件，从问对问题开始。
zh-CN.heroCardCopy: 材料、螺纹形式、工况及当地合规要求，比外观相似更重要。

topics.title: 螺纹与连接方式
topics.summary: BSP、NPT、卡套、卡压和快插连接系统并非都能互换。

topics.title: 材料选择
topics.summary: 黄铜、铜、不锈钢及聚合物均须根据具体用途核查材料适用性。

topics.title: 压力、温度与介质
topics.summary: 工况及所需认可会影响阀门或管件是否适用。

products.name: 黄铜螺纹弯头
products.description: 用于螺纹管道组件中改变方向的连接件。
products.spec: 公称尺寸、内外螺纹、螺纹类型、材料牌号。
products.caution: 核查 BSP/NPT 螺纹兼容性及适用的饮用水要求。

products.name: 卡套式直通接头
products.description: 常用于连接相容铜管或塑料管的机械式接头。
products.spec: 管外径、卡套结构、管材兼容性、额定压力。
products.caution: 安装程序及允许使用的管材因系统而异。

products.name: 球阀
products.description: 流体输送系统中常用的四分之一转隔离阀。
products.spec: 通径、阀体与阀座材料、阀门额定参数、端部连接。
products.caution: 阀门额定参数必须适合温度、压力及使用介质。

products.name: 止回阀
products.description: 用于在相容系统中减少介质逆流的单向阀。
products.spec: 开启压力、安装方向、连接方式、材料、试验标准。
products.caution: 不能代替法规要求的倒流防止装置。

products.name: 不锈钢三通
products.description: 管道安装中用于分支的三向连接件。
products.spec: 材料牌号、支管尺寸、管系列或壁厚、连接方式。
products.caution: 向制造商核实具体材料牌号及检测文件。

products.name: 减压阀
products.description: 用于需要控制下游压力的调节阀。
products.spec: 入口压力范围、出口调压范围、流量能力、认证要求。
products.caution: 选型和安装应由具备资质的专业人员核查。

guides.title: BSP 与 NPT：需要核查什么
guides.summary: 公称尺寸相似的螺纹管件，其牙型及密封方式可能不同。
checks: 在图纸中确认准确的螺纹标准及尺寸。
索取尺寸数据或量规检验信息，不能只看产品照片。
明确密封方式、流体类型及当地规范要求。

guides.title: 如何编写更清晰的询价单（RFQ）
guides.summary: 规格不完整容易造成报价错误及代用成本增加。
checks: 列明数量、图纸及实际使用工况。
明确检测报告、材质证明及包装要求。
询问样品政策、交期、贸易条款及不包含的项目。

guides.title: 核查阀门报价
guides.summary: 只有技术条件一致，价格比较才有意义。
checks: 核实材料牌号及检测文件的真实性。
比较压力与温度适用范围及产品标准。
明确检验范围、备件及质保条款。

faq.question: 本站销售管件吗？
faq.answer: 不销售。本站是学习参考原型，不提供结算或实时供应商报价服务。

faq.question: 外观相似的管件可以使用相同螺纹吗？
faq.answer: 不一定。螺纹几何参数和适用密封方式可能不同，应依据标准及图纸确认，不能仅凭外观判断。

faq.question: 制造商是否经过验证？
faq.answer: 目前尚未发布制造商资料。未来收录时，将区分公开记录、供应商声明及经过独立审核的文件。

zh-CN.disclosure: 技术说明仅用于一般知识学习，不代表工程批准、采购建议或产品合规证明。
